title: Write It Like You See It: Detectable Differences in Clinical Notes By Race Lead To Differential Model Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting patient self-reported race (Black vs. White) from race-redacted clinical nursing notes using machine learning models (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, SciBERT), analyzing the predictive lexical features and topics, and running a simulation experiment to evaluate if models propagate synthetically induced racial disparities in clinical treatment recommendations.
